answer_1.quote: Coherence models that can evaluate machine-generated text have become the need of the hour.
answer_1.outputs: Machine-generated texts such as summaries from summarization systems and continuations from language models.

answer_2.quote: All evaluations on downstream tasks are conducted in a pairwise setting to enable a fair comparison.

answer_4.quote: Using these texts, we conducted a user study on Amazon Mechanical Turk. Workers were instructed about the concept of coherence and shown examples of coherent and incoherent texts. Given the prompt, they were asked to choose the more coherent text out of two given language model outputs; they were also given an option to choose neither in case the texts were equally coherent/incoherent
answer_4.guideline: Workers were instructed about the concept of coherence and shown examples of coherent and incoherent texts.
